form_title: Microsoft Foundry Service: Request for Quota Increase

supported_v1.form_unit_rule: requested_tpm / 1000; chat kTPM or ADM capacity units

model_field_order: Global Standard Region (only if visible after model selection)
observations_not_rules: Question numbers change when conditional fields disappear; match labels, not question numbers.
The model and region dropdowns use an outer role=listbox, a selected placeholder role=option, and an inner role=listbox. Select options from the inner listbox to avoid duplicate matches.
Some models do not show a region question after model selection. Do not force a region or infer regional availability from this.
The exact gpt-5 entry was missing from the live Global Standard dropdown on the checked date. Recheck live choices each run; this is not a permanent deny list.
A listed model is not proof of lifecycle support, deployability, available quota, or approval of the requested amount.
The page can scroll in an inner office-form-content element. A fullPage screenshot of the document may contain only the current viewport.
Focus can shift while masked fields initialize, sending a subscription GUID to a different textbox. Read committed values after blur and compare all fields again before clicking.
An interrupted tool response does not prove the browser task stopped. Inspect the existing ledger and running operation before resuming.
